scenarios.title: A player discards down to the maximum hand size during the cleanup step

setup.notes: It is A's cleanup step and A's maximum hand size is seven.

decisions: A discards Giant Growth to reduce the hand to seven.

variants.label: eight_cards
variants.expected: A discards one card, Giant Growth, which goes to A's graveyard; A ends with seven cards in hand.

variants.label: seven_cards
variants.delta: A's hand holds seven cards (Giant Growth removed).
variants.expected: A discards nothing and keeps seven cards; the graveyard stays empty.

variants.label: reliquary_tower
variants.delta: A controls Reliquary Tower, so A has no maximum hand size, with eight cards in hand.
variants.expected: A discards nothing and keeps eight cards in hand.
